claims.quote: The emerald betta, Betta smaragdina, is a bubble-nesting labyrinth fish from the Khorat Plateau in eastern Thailand and Mekong tributaries in Laos.

regions.quote: The plateau is drained by the Mun, Chi, Songkhram, and Loei rivers, all of which belong to the Mekong watershed, and B. smaragdina has also been recorded from Mekong tributaries in central Laos.

regions.name: Khorat Plateau
regions.quote: Native to the Khorat Plateau in eastern Thailand, a saucer-shaped upland region enclosed by the Mekong River main channel to the north and east.
